
```{python}
import boto3
import json
import os

# s3_tif_file='' # from pagnator object

json_name =  '000001-a.tif'.split('.')[0] +'.json' # '000001-a.tif' will come from client pagnator

# json_data = extract_text_from_file(s3_tif_file)
s3_client = boto3.client('s3')

response = s3_client.get_object( Bucket=os.environ['AWS_BUCKET'],
                     Key=f'book_json/{json_name}')

json_data = response['Body'].read().decode('UTF-8')
data = json.loads(json_data)

from pprint import pprint
pprint(data)
```
